items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 19 at 12:31PM PDT until October 23 at 3:00AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to
elevated surf of 3 to 6 feet expected.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles
County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through late Thursday night.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion and tidal overflows may
occur across south-facing beaches especially along the Malibu
Coast and in the Long Beach area.
items.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.

items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued October 21 at 10:08AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
A moderate storm system will impact our coastal waters today
through Thursday, bringing a chance of thunderstorms to the area.
Thunderstorm activity is likely to be most hazardous for the
waters south and east of Point Conception with peak timing
expected this afternoon through Thursday morning.

Any thunderstorm that forms will be capable of producing local
gusts up to gale force, rough seas, dangerous lightning, heavy
rainfall with reduced visibility, and waterspouts.
